observations: Photo 0 shows a Nikon-branded camera body with a top plate labeled “Z fc” and a lens mount area; no lens front cap is visible in this shot.
Photo 1 shows the front of a lens with focus/zoom markings and the camera top dials; the lens appears to be attached to the body.
Photo 2 shows the camera with multiple accessories: at least one battery, a battery charger, and two lens caps (one appears to be a front cap and another a cap labeled for APS-C).

claims.claim: Nikon z fc is a retro-inspired, slr-style mirrorless camera featuring a 20.9-megapixel aps-c...
claims.evidence: Photos show the Nikon Z fc body (photo 0) but do not show the sensor megapixel specification or any screen/menu confirming the stated specs.

risks.risk: Lens model is not readable; pricing depends heavily on whether it’s the kit lens (and which one) or a different lens.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the lens front ring and the full lens label (model name/number) plus the rear mount contact area; also a photo of the lens information screen if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as Nikon Z fc body + unknown lens (worst case: kit lens not confirmed / value reduced).

risks.risk: Shutter count / usage level is unknown; high shutter count can reduce resale value.
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo from the camera showing shutter count (or a service menu/EXIF tool output).
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with unknown shutter count (worst case: higher wear).

risks.risk: Sensor condition and internal dust/scratches are unknown (photos don’t show sensor or test results).
risks.proof: A test shot of a blank white wall at f/16 and a close crop showing dust/specks, plus a photo of the sensor (if the seller can safely show it).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing cleaning/with possible dust (worst case: treat as not fully clean).

risks.risk: Functionality of key features is unknown (autofocus, IBIS/AF performance, buttons/dials, hot shoe, ports).
risks.proof: Video clip showing autofocus tracking on a moving subject and a quick check of: menu navigation, playback, recording, and any port/charging indicator.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified (worst case: assume some functions may be faulty).

risks.risk: Battery health and charging reliability are unknown; included battery may be weak or charger may be incompatible.
risks.proof: A photo of battery label (model) and a clip showing the camera charging and powering on from the battery (with battery icon/percentage).
risks.if_unproven: Price as battery/charger condition unknown (worst case: battery not strong).

risks.risk: Missing items/packaging are unknown (e.g., strap, USB cable, original box, eyepiece cover, manuals).
risks.proof: A full laid-out inventory photo showing every included item and any missing parts.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete bundle (worst case: only what’s shown).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the lens model/label (front ring and side text) to confirm the exact lens.
Screenshot/photo showing shutter count (or a reliable shutter-count report).
Test photos: blank wall at f/16 (dust check) and one normal shot to confirm AF and image quality.
Short video showing autofocus tracking + menu/button/dial responsiveness.
Photo of battery label and a clip proving charging + powering on with battery percentage.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a Nikon Z fc body, but the lens model, shutter count, and functional/sensor condition are not verifiable from the images. Without those, a worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
